main_result: If H is independent of (L,V), f_H<=1, ||p_{L,V}||_infinity<=K, and Q=2aHL+bL^2+2cLV+dV^2 with ad!=0, then ||p_Q||_infinity<=6 K^(2/3)|a|^(-2/3)|d|^(-1/3). For an exact-rank-three exact-coloop physical row with zero diagonal coefficient, K<=2 and the spectral gap gives |a|,|d|>=1, hence ||p_Q||_infinity<9.525.
source_result_application: The required pinned ruled signature-(2,1) theorem gives p_Q(s)<=pi*sqrt(2)<4.443 on the majority-sign side of the same exact-coloop geometry; the new receiver pays all levels in that chamber.
partner_use: Fresh account03/B10 r28 endpoint-stable hub-partner geometry was consumed to identify that positive longitudinal leakage introduces a third same-bank leaf aggregate; at zero leakage the geometry reduces to the dependent two-aggregate form closed here.
unpaid_detail: Extend the receiver uniformly to the generic positive-leakage near-coloop form containing a third ORIGINAL-leaf aggregate, without conditioning on it, without a conditional-density/fiber supremum, and without coefficient-continuity assumptions.
provenance_guard: Only the ORIGINAL coloop coordinate is used as genuinely independent of the leaf bank. The transverse pair is retained jointly; no post-rotation independence is asserted.
